runtimeArchitecture.chunkResolutionHook: Implemented in next.config.mjs. Intercepts Module._resolveFilename to dynamically map ./<id>.js chunks to .next/server/chunks/<id>.js or .next/server/<id>.js, preventing 'Cannot find module ./331.js' crashes.
runtimeArchitecture.cacheIsolation: Controlled via scripts/clean.js. Purges .next/server before dev or build runs to eliminate dev/prod artifact collisions.
runtimeArchitecture.offlineResilience: System font fallbacks registered in app/globals.css and next.config.mjs headers configured for CORS and immutable static caching.
